goal: Implement Macro BTC Shield, Daily Circuit Breakers, Liquidity Spread Guard, Crash Recovery Hook and Multi-Capital Validation ($10, $100, $1,000 USD) in Auto Trader BETA

contracts.interfaces: export interface AutoTraderRunnerConfig { assignedCapital: number; enableBtcMacroShield?: boolean; btcDropThreshold15mPct?: number; btcRsiPanicThreshold?: number; maxDailyLossPct?: number; dailyProfitTargetPct?: number; maxAllowedSpreadPct?: number; autoRestore?: boolean; }

execution_steps: Write comprehensive unit test suite in frontend/src/__tests__/auto_trader_macro_shield.test.js covering BTC panic defense, daily loss circuit breaker, daily profit lock, spread filter, crash recovery, and multi-capital tiers ($10, $100, $1,000)
Run node --test to verify red phase
Implement evaluateBtcMacroRegime, daily risk tracking, spread safety gate, autoRestore, and multi-capital precision in frontend/src/lib/autoTraderRunner.ts
Run node --test to verify green phase
Run regression test suites (TSK-005, TSK-006, TSK-007, TSK-008)
Run npm run build and npx oxlint to guarantee zero errors and zero warnings
Update scripts/run_live_paper_test.js with --capital=10|100|1000 and live BTC shield / circuit breaker logging
Execute live paper benchmark tests across $10, $100, and $1,000 tiers
acceptance_criteria: evaluateBtcMacroRegime triggers BTC_PANIC_DEFENSE when BTC drops >= btcDropThreshold15mPct (default 1.2%) or BTC 15m RSI < btcRsiPanicThreshold (default 35.0)
maxDailyLossPct halts new entries when realized daily loss reaches or exceeds -2.0%
dailyProfitTargetPct preserves gains when realized daily profit reaches or exceeds +3.0%
maxAllowedSpreadPct rejects candidates with bid/ask spread > 0.15%
autoRestore resumes existing open position and Break-Even / Trailing Stop state from persistence file
Multi-capital validation confirms identical percentage performance across $10, $100, and $1,000 tiers
All unit tests pass with exit code 0
definition_of_done: Zero private Binance API or real money endpoints are used
